source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Once per turn, during the opponent's Shooting phase, one of your models that has this ability may respond when an attack by a unit able to **FLY** destroys another **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit of yours no more than 6" from this model. Once every attack by the attacking unit is resolved:

- the model can shoot as though in your own Shooting phase
- it can target only that enemy unit, provided that unit is an eligible target
